svg.title: ZavaFinance .NET and Python - Development and Staging / Production architecture
svg.desc: The .NET and Python implementations use native Activity hosting and Microsoft Agent Framework. Development uses the Foundry-managed Public Preview state feature inside Foundry with no SLA. Planned Staging and Production each use an independent GA Cosmos DB for NoSQL account outside Foundry; their version-aware state adapter is not implemented. Azure Monitor, Key Vault and private connectivity are planned. The Activity API remains Preview. All official Microsoft SVG stencils are embedded.
svg.metadata: Icons: Azure Architecture Center V24, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Power Platform and Microsoft Fabric. Source and terms are linked in the architecture documentation.

text.tspan: 18 September 2026 | Native Activity + Microsoft Agent Framework | One finance tool per turn; answers returned verbatim
DEV: state is a Foundry feature - no extra storage resource.
STAGING / PROD: planned Cosmos state; adapter not implemented.
CURRENT - independent .NET and Python runtimes, Bots, packages and state.
Existing Foundry project | separate implementation identities
Native Activity, AgentSession, tools and middleware
At most one outer model request; verbatim tool reply
Process-owned work; no durable in-flight recovery
At most one finance tool per turn
Existing Fabric workspace + KPIpedia; the Fabric capacity is currently in West US 3.
Foundry runtime / session logs are available; dedicated Application Insights wiring is not confirmed.
Development persistence needs only the Foundry project state feature, not an extra storage resource.
Saved conversation memory survives restarts; accepted work and OAuth continuations may not.
Caller-bound HMAC state holds intent, not delegated tokens or permissioned finance-result bodies.
TARGET DESIGN - separate deployment per environment; not yet deployed.
Separate Foundry resources / project for each environment
Native Activity, AgentSession, tools and middleware
At most one outer model request; verbatim tool reply
Process-owned work; no durable in-flight recovery
At most one finance tool per turn
Separate data / knowledge per environment; staging must not inherit production data permissions.
PLANNED CROSS-CUTTING CONTROLS | apply to host and dependencies
Bicep + gated CI/CD + federated identity | same tested artifact | lower staging capacity, same controls | recovery targets + restore drills
* Activity API remains Preview even with GA Cosmos. Validate fresh SSO, two-user isolation, concurrent turns and financial accuracy.
Cosmos DB persistence does not add durable execution. No queue / workflow service is assumed. Private networking needs end-to-end validation.
Solid arrows: application calls / replies. Dashed arrows: identity. Dashed environment border: planned. Boundaries are logical, not VNets. Official Microsoft SVG stencils embedded.
